definitions.comparison: Parent12k versus14k is descriptive interim comparison, not final H0 verdict or isolated causal correction test.
definitions.fp: Predicted lesion minus TP; volume uses each case native affine determinant.
definitions.hits: Any voxel overlap;26-connected reference components. Predicted component count is NOT unmatched FP component count on positive cases.
definitions.recall: Macro-positive recall averages TP/GT per positive case; pooled recall sums TP/GT across voxels. These differ.
definitions.small: Total native annotated lesion volume per case under1000mm3; not individual lesion size.

future_policy: Future evaluation binds predicted-pancreas-proximity-5mm-v1 with raw retention and paired qualified raw/filtered results; not retrofitted to this frozen evaluator.
scope: Complete raw provided-pancreas native development evaluation; exploratory. No5mm filtering applied; live selection unchanged.
